newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD, DDI agree on business tie-up.
newsitem.headline: KDD, DDI agree on business tie-up.

text.p: Japan's international telecommunications company Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) said on Monday that it had agreed with domestic long-distance telecommunications company DDI Corp on a business tie-up.
They will sign an agreement on Tuesday, a KDD spokesman said.
The two firms expect to attract more customers and boost competitiveness through the alliance, the spokesman said, without elaborating on the details of the business tie-up.
He added that the companies were not considering an equity tie-up.
Japanese daily Asahi Shimbun said on Monday that the two telecommunications firms would offer a cut of about 20 percent in international and domestic phone rates to individual users from October.
The paper said they would also jointly set up facilities, develop multimedia products and connect their services.
